data.content_ref: inline:The problem 37aa16746f81 shares mechanism with SRC_004 regarding the 'Conflict-Resolution Trace,' proposing that the presence of 'documented friction' (divergent internal audit trails) is the only durable evidence of reliability gain. This relation is refuted if panels with perfectly linear 'Yes' trails (no documented struggle) achieve the same or higher reliability scores than those with complex, resolved conflict traces.
